name: R7 Orbit
tagline: Field notes on building with AI
description: News, builds and the things in between: writing, videos, projects and code about building with AI.

author.name: Hunter Newton
author.bio: I build software and apps with AI agents, and I'm building R7 Orbit, a desktop app for directing them. I'm a Product Designer and I design products, systems, and interactive experiences. I post what I learn, including the parts that don't work.
